The first release of beets-rs, a Rust port of [beets](https://github.com/beetbox/beets) 2.14.

- **One binary, `beet`**, with beets' commands, query language, path templates and config syntax. MusicBrainz autotagging, a SQLite library with beets' schema, and the bundled plugins are ported natively, with no Python.
- **Checked against beets:** a differential suite runs about 4,000 cases through both tools and finds no unexpected differences. The known, deliberate ones are listed in `docs/DIFFERENCES.md`.
- **6–22x faster than beets** on a 10,000-track library (see Performance in the README).
- **Safe to try next to beets:** config and library live in `~/.config/beets-rs/` (or `$BEETSRSDIR`), so an existing beets library is never touched. `beet migrate-beets` copies one in. See `docs/MIGRATING.md`.

Downloads are for Linux (x86_64, aarch64) and macOS (Apple silicon, Intel). Unpack and put `beet` on your `PATH`. Each archive has a `.sha256` checksum.
